shipped_rows.title_o: Economic Inequality, Immigrants and Selective Solidarity: From Perceived Lack of Opportunity to In-group Favoritism

blind_target.authors: Alesina, Alberto, Miano, Armando and Stantcheva, Stefanie
blind_target.title: Immigration and redistribution.
blind_target.evidence_quote:
Our pre-registered (see Appendix B.1 for blinded version) survey design builds
upon and replicates Magni (2021) and Alesina, Miano and Stantcheva (2023)
with a quota-representative (age, gender, education, region) sample of the sur-
vey company Kantar.
blind_target.outcome_quote:
Third, priming on immigration does not
make respondents support a reduction of redistribution as previously proposed by
Alesina, Miano and Stantcheva (2023); rather, it even decreases welfare chauvinis-
tic attitudes.
blind_target.outcome_reasoning: The central immigration effect on redistribution fails; successful manipulation checks do not establish successful replication of that claim.

luna_triage.reason: The paper explicitly includes Alesina, Miano and Stantcheva (2023) among the priming studies it replicates, and reports the immigration-prime result against their stated finding. The only supplied shipped row is Magni (2020), a different original; no alternate Alesina row is supplied.
